## LogoOptions type

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type LogoOptions = {
    path: string;
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    top?: number;
    bottom?: number;
    left?: number;
    right?: number;
    objectFit?: 'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'none' | 'scale-down';
};
```

## Remarks

Do not specify opposite offsets (i.e., top and bottom, or left and right) at the same time. If you need to change "snap"-side using [Player.configure()](./player.player.configure.md)<!-- -->, always reset old offsets to zero.

## Example


```ts
player.configure({ logo: { left: 0, top: 0, right: 25, bottom: 20}})
```
